summary: This informational document gives guidelines for people serving as an IETF liaison to another organization, such as a standards body or industry forum. It expands on the roles of liaison managers and representatives, including their mandate, expectations, tasks and responsibilities. The IAB procedures for liaisons are in RFC 4052.

eli5.summary: When the IETF works with another group, someone acts as messenger. This is the job description for that messenger.

questions: how does the ietf work with other standards bodies
